name: SDF Value Computation
definition: A compute shader kernel that calculates the Signed Distance Function (SDF) value for each voxel in the grid. It transforms grid coordinates to world space, evaluates the SDF function, and stores the result.
summary: SDF Value Computation evaluates the Signed Distance Function for a voxel grid by transforming local coordinates to world space, differing from multi-view methods by focusing solely on single-shape geometric evaluation.
